title: Do-San

symbol.name: Do-San
symbol.meaning: The patriot Ahn Chang-ho · ITF pattern 3 of 24

note.p: Do-San is the pen name of the patriot Ahn Chang-ho (1876–1938), who gave his life to education and Korean independence; the 24 movements stand for his whole life. You start in the middle of the A–B line facing D: high blocks and punches to B and A, a guarding block and fingertip thrust down the stem, a full turn to free the hand and two back fists, blocks and punches to E and F on the far line, wedging blocks, kicks and double punches on the two diagonals back toward C, two rising blocks, and two knife-hand strikes in sitting stance where you began.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (24 movements, one technique each; 15–16 and 19–20 are fast double punches). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the far line; CE and CF are the diagonals back toward C. Finish by bringing the right foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in parallel ready stance: feet parallel and one shoulder-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a left walking stance. Left outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
Move the left foot back onto the A–B line, then turn clockwise into a right walking stance facing A. Right outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right straight fingertip middle thrust, the left hand under the right elbow, with a kihap.

Twist the right hand palm-down, turning the body with it as if freeing it from a grip, keep turning counter-clockwise a full circle and step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Left back fist high side strike.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right back fist high side strike.
Turn 270° to the left: move the left foot round to E into a left walking stance facing E. Left outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
Move the left foot back onto the E–F line, then turn clockwise into a right walking stance facing F. Right outer forearm high side block.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Turn to face CE: move the left foot toward CE into a left walking stance. Outer forearm high wedging block.
Right middle front snap kick toward CE, the hands held in the wedging block.
Set the right foot down toward CE into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 15.
Turn to face CF: move the right foot toward CF into a right walking stance. Outer forearm high wedging block.
Left middle front snap kick toward CF, the hands held in the wedging block.
Set the left foot down toward CF into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
In the same stance, right middle punch, fast after 19.
Turn to face C: move the left foot toward C into a left walking stance with a left forearm rising block.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance with a right forearm rising block, with a kihap.
Turn counter-clockwise: move the left foot toward B into a sitting stance facing D. Left knife-hand middle side strike to B.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot toward A into a sitting stance facing D. Right knife-hand middle side strike to A.
